summary: Yu Suzuki and YS Net's rail shooter, first launched through Apple Arcade and later released on PC and consoles.

entries.title: Air Twister

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively with current patches.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at highest stable settings

primary.why: Air Twister launched on iOS and macOS via Apple Arcade in 2022, then came to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, and Windows in 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible non-subscription route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release natively at the highest stable settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as equivalent console options.
